page.layout: One page of text, running head at top; a small marginal note at the right, beside the line "quiddam * ἀχοινωνήτου;" (the note reads "infe-ciabile"). Page number at head right.

main_text.p: Hæc & talia satiare nos scriptionis poterant : melior ratio revocavit, & suasit publico prodesse quâ possum. Opes atque arma nostra, stilus. Quem tamen in alium numquam stringam aut proferam : absit : Christianum me commemini, id est, Sacerdotem pacis. Habet quidem gloria, ait Plinius, præsertim in studiis, quiddam * ἀχοινωνήτου;infe-ciabile. nolo in me expetat. & quandocumque moriar, feram mecum hanc conscientiam,

page.notes: The marginal note "infeciabile" is a small note set beside the Greek word; the Greek word is transcribed as printed, with doubtful letters possible. The asterisk after "quiddam" is a printed reference mark.
